rules.semantic: A failed player special voices its reason only when the player can act on it (NOT ENOUGH MP, unavailable, disabled, the script's refusal); engine states (dead, statless, non-living, no failure) stay silent.

arms.observable: the reason string is emitted as a seat notification + SOUND_CLANG

rules.semantic: A seat hears at most one failure cue per throttle window (kSimCueThrottleTicks); a mashed key does not flood the feed.

arms.observable: no event (cue dropped inside the kSimCueThrottleTicks window)

note: Compound observables split into separate arms (fixer policy): an arm is asserted only when a cited test pins its whole observable. Warm arm: sim_input_failed_special_cue_is_seat_addressed_and_throttled ASSERT_EQ(1, count_cue) on every frame 1..kSimCueThrottleTicks-1 and ASSERT_EQ(2) across 10 held frames. The nullptr sub-case is reached by no test (same gap as sim_input_handler.cpp:41 silent arm).

rules.semantic: A successful cast says nothing; a script refusal on the HELD repeat (the family still on its own cooldown) stays silent, the running special being the answer; any other failure is voiced.

New Ability Select belt: a valid belt key sets the slot and the shift from the entry; a slot the hero's level has not opened refuses with 'LEVEL N NEEDED', an empty or malformed key with 'NO ABILITY THERE', voiced only on the press (not the hold).

rules.condition: alive && awake && visible && unpossessed && Living && unseated && myguy && team && seat_may_claim
rules.semantic: A seat that needs a body takes first a player character (a hero with a company record) of its own team that is alive, awake, visible, unpossessed and not held by another seat (and, with Gameplay Fixes on, not a walker our side charmed).
With no player character left, a seat takes any eligible member of its own team; it never takes a walker of another team (the 2002 'ANYONE' pass is gone).
Switch Character cycles through eligible bodies in object-list order after the current one, wrapping to the start; Shift cycles backward. A current body not in the list yields nothing.

arms.observable: first eligible after current, else from the start
first eligible before current, else from the end

rules.condition: index out of range || name missing/NONE || !slot_open(level)
rules.semantic: Switch Special steps to the next special and wraps to slot 1 past the last slot, at an unnamed (NONE) slot, or at a slot the hero's level has not opened.

past the end (index > NUM_SPECIALS-1) or negative

note: Compound observables split into separate arms (fixer policy): an arm is asserted only when a cited test pins its whole observable. No test cycles from slot 5 of a family with five named specials at level 13+ (index 6), nor from a negative current_special.

rules.semantic: Switching away from a hero hands it back to its AI (its own act type restored, unseated).

rules.condition: !dead && !dormant && !hidden && !possessed && Living && friendly && same team && real_team 255 && unseated && control_claim_allowed
rules.semantic: Switch Character never hands a seat a dead, dormant, hidden, possessed, charmed (real team set), foreign-team or other-seat body, nor one the ownership policy refuses.

A seat may only take a body the ownership policy allows (owner-locked networked games keep each machine on its own heroes); a claim takes it under the seat's keys and clears its commands except a forced fright and charm.
The failure-cue throttle cools one tick per input tick even while the seat's hero is dead or respawning.

New Specials possession: a seat whose ghost rides a body is moved to drive the body (and back to the ghost on release); the tick the seat moves is spent on the move, so a Special still held from the possessing cast casts nothing on the host.

arms.observable: new_control = host (or rider), control_hp reported, nothing else processed

rules.semantic: A supplied unseated control is claimed this tick; if the ownership policy refuses it the seat is treated as having no control (#333).
A seat whose hero is dead but due to respawn keeps that exact hero (it does not jump to a teammate and miss the countdown).
With no live control the seat takes the policy's verdict: follow (spectate, no end-game), end the game (company wiped), or claim the next eligible body, which is seated at once.
A seated hero with banked bonus rounds spends one per input tick on repeating its last step (if it was moving).
Switch Character fires once per press (debounced until the key is released) and not while the Cheat key is held (Cheat+Switch changes team instead).
New Specials: Switch Character inside a possessed body lets the body go; the seat returns to the ghost where it stands, and the next press cycles heroes as usual.
With no one else to switch to, the seat keeps its hero and is told 'NO ONE TO SWITCH TO' (#223).

arms.observable: control = anchor, re-claimed, cue 'NO ONE TO SWITCH TO'

rules.semantic: The hero switched to is taken under the seat's keys in the same tick (it does not take one more AI act).

New Specials: a hidden hero (dug in, or a ghost riding a body) answers only Special (press or hold; a second press brings a dug-in hero up) and Switch Character: no walking, firing, yelling or special cycling.
Switch Special advances once per press (debounced until released).
The Yell cooldown counts down once per input tick.

rules.condition: pressed(Yell) && !yo_delay && !Shift && !Cheat / Living && not seated && same team && !leader
rules.semantic: Yell (Yo!) recruits every unseated teammate of order Living that has no leader: it follows the hero (leader set, foe dropped, a forced 100-step follow); the filter has NO dead/dormant/hidden check, so a dead, dormant or hidden teammate is recruited too (classic quirk, old game view.cpp:626-629 identical). The hero cannot yell again for 30 ticks.

arms.observable: Living same-team unled unseated allies get leader=hero; yo_delay 30; SOUND_YO and Yo! notification (result + sim events)

arms.when: yell: foe dropped and forced follow
arms.observable: recruited allies foe null and COMMAND_FOLLOW x100 forced onto the queue

dead, dormant or hidden teammate with no leader
arms.observable: still recruited: leader=hero, foe null, COMMAND_FOLLOW x100 queued on the corpse/dormant/hidden body (classic quirk)

missing_arms: yell: foe dropped and forced follow
ally already led or seated (ACT_CONTROL) or other team or order not Living
dead, dormant or hidden teammate with no leader

(no Yo!, no SOUND_YO).

rules.semantic: Shift+Yell toggles Summon Defense: on, every same-team friendly object (no order filter, the hero itself included) follows the hero (leader set, foe dropped, ACTION_FOLLOW) and 'SUMMONING DEFENSE!'; pressed again, every unseated living teammate returns to normal and 'RELEASING MEN!'; any other action on the hero is just reset.

arms.observable: friendly team-mates (hero included) ACTION_FOLLOW; notification SUMMONING DEFENSE! (result + sim event), no sound

missing_arms: hero action 0: leader set and foe dropped
note: Compound observables split into separate arms (fixer policy): an arm is asserted only when a cited test pins its whole observable. Summon follow/notification: sim_input_shift_yell_summon_and_release (notify_text, ally ACTION_FOLLOW, single Notification event) and view_input_yell_and_shift_yell_team_actions (control and ally ACTION_FOLLOW). The Shift+Yell leader/foe writes are asserted by no test (the leader asserts in those files belong to the plain-yell branch, row :460).

rules.semantic: A seat never drives a hero another seat (or the AI) holds: input past this point is dropped.
A seated hero mid-animation advances its animation from the input tick as well as its act (the classic double-speed player animation).

arms.observable: animate() once here (and again in living::act)

rules.semantic: A seat that changed body this tick clears the new body's commands, except a leading forced fright and charm.
A frozen seated hero ignores every key; pressing Special or Fire says 'FROZEN!'; each input tick thaws it by one and the 1 -> 0 thaw writes the freeze-immunity window.
While a hero carries out a queued action (a shove, a fright, a special's command) the seat's movement, fire and special keys are ignored.

arms.observable: held direction does not walkstep (xpos, lastx unchanged)
Fire press does not init_fire (ani_type stays ANI_WALK, busy 0)
Special press does not cast (MP, effects, cues unchanged)

note: Compound observables split into separate arms (fixer policy): an arm is asserted only when a cited test pins its whole observable. No walk: sim_input_cheat_gates_and_command_queue_skip_movement_block (lastx 0, xpos unchanged). No fire: sim_input_fire_press_attacks_and_a_queued_command_suppresses_it (ANI_WALK, busy 0); that test presses Special too but asserts nothing about MP or the event log.

rules.semantic: On a belt tick the slot and shift come from the belt entry and the physical Shift key means nothing; on a classic tick the Shift key sets the shift (alternate) for the cast.
Pressing Special casts the current special once; a belt refusal casts nothing (never the stale slot).

rules.condition: cast && queued commands && enemy_freeze > 0 && caster hostile to my_team
rules.semantic: A seated caster on a side the running FREEZE TIME freezes is told 'SPECIALS FROZEN' when its cast left work queued that the act freeze will strand; an inline cast or a failed one is not.
note: Compound observables split into separate arms (fixer policy): an arm is asserted only when a cited test pins its whole observable. Inline cast: sim_input_enemy_freeze_stays_quiet_for_an_inline_cast (count_seat_lines 0, count_clang 0). No freeze: the clean twin in sim_input_enemy_freeze_cue_marks_a_stranded_command_queue (same queued RUSH, count_seat_lines 0). No test runs enemy_freeze with a my_team-friendly caster.

rules.condition: control->hidden() after a press cast / after a held cast
rules.semantic: New Specials: a cast that hides its caster (a ghost entering a body, a skeleton digging in) ends the seat's input for that tick: no step and no fire after it.
Fire attacks on the press and keeps attacking while held.
Holding Special recasts once per tick from the tick after the press; one tap is one cast (#228).
A direction key walks the hero one stepsize (walkstep); standing still, an always-animate hero still cycles its frames.
